description: This file implements Power State Coordination Interface (PSCI) functions for CPU power management in Zephyr OS, including power off/on, system reset, and version detection, with support for different PSCI versions and conduit methods.

methods.name: psci_to_dev_err
methods.description: Converts PSCI return codes to device error codes.

methods.name: pm_cpu_off
methods.description: Puts the CPU into off state via PSCI.

methods.name: pm_cpu_on
methods.description: Turns on a CPU core via PSCI.

methods.name: z_sys_poweroff
methods.description: Performs system power off if CONFIG_POWEROFF is enabled.

methods.name: psci_features_check
methods.description: Checks if a PSCI feature is supported based on version.

methods.name: pm_system_reset
methods.description: Resets the system with specified reset type.

methods.name: __invoke_psci_fn_hvc
methods.description: Invokes a PSCI function via HVC call.

methods.name: __invoke_psci_fn_smc
methods.description: Invokes a PSCI function via SMC call.

methods.name: set_conduit_method
methods.description: Sets the communication method (HVC or SMC) for PSCI.

methods.name: psci_init
methods.description: Initializes PSCI driver and detects capabilities.
